best_idea: Use a `s[4][256]` layout to ensure that increments to the same bin are spread across different cache lines, reducing cache line contention and RMW-related stalls on hot bins.

best_lineage.idea: Use 4 sub-histograms in a `s[256][4]` layout to ensure that consecutive increments of the same bin hit different elements within the same cache line, breaking the store-to-load dependency chain on hot bins.
